newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary NABI shr issue 7 times oversubscribed - MTI.
newsitem.headline: Hungary NABI shr issue 7 times oversubscribed - MTI.

text.p: The domestic share offering of Hungarian busmaker North American Bus Industries (NABI) closed on Thursday seven times oversubscribed, the Hungarian economic news agency MTI-Econews reported on Friday.
The agency reports that 30 to 40 institutional investors applied for shares, with some offering to buy all the shares, which were offered at 3,280 forints.
NABI shares are expected to appear on the Budapest Stock Exchange in three weeks once the capital increase is registered with the Court of Company Registration.

As a result of the issue NABI's subscribed capital has increased from 2.765 billion forints to 4.47 billion and its main shareholder, the First Hungary Fund, has reduced its stake from 100 percent to 55.93 percent.
According to the IPO prospectus, NABI is expected to receive a net $27.9 million from the sale of the 1,704,700 new shares. The cost of the IPO was estimated at $500,000.
NABI will use $19.7 million of the revenues to settle debts, including NABI Incorporated's $6.2 million debt to the First Hungary Fund, MTI said.
NABI Inc is a NABI Rt subsidiary based in Anniston, Alabama.
